summary: Outlook Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $100 million through H.C. Wainwright as sales agent. No price per share or premium is stated; sales depend on market conditions. The board is not making a recommendation, and no advisor is named beyond the agent. Shares trade on Nasdaq under symbol OTLK. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation. The filing details offering mechanics, commissions, and risk factors. No special-situation event—such as acquisition, tender, or restructuring—is present.
